training_reference.scope: Unified full-domain dense skill curriculum; V5-specific mechanics and research targets
training_reference.runtime: 35D actor / 81D critic, stock PPO, V5 closed chain, 200Hz physics / 50Hz policy / rollout 24
training_reference.height_shape: Original narrow exponential and quadratic plus a wide companion; analytic vertical-velocity reference
training_reference.schedule: 52000 reference updates; full ground domain, landing, jump, terrain, robust integration
training_reference.optimization: Scratch ground learning at fixed 1e-4; accepted actor transfer and fresh critic warmup at fixed 3e-5 in later phases
training_reference.rehearsal: All ground heights/speeds/spin rates covered from the first ground phase; later phases split new skills and prior skills 50/50
training_reference.stage_transfer: Accepted actor, fresh critic and optimizer; original models retained as independent comparison candidates
training_reference.regression: Finite phase budgets and regression checks; final behavior acceptance remains separate from engineering probe success
training_reference.recovery: Same-contract optimizer resume; no migration of V5.2/V5.3 adaptive windows
training_reference.mechanical_margin: Penalize excess stop proximity relative to the commanded-height reference; hard travel and closure failures unchanged
training_reference.terrain_targets: 15deg slopes, 0.10m ascent, 0.15m descent, 0.04m stairs are research goals, not certified hardware capabilities
training_reference.causality: Coherent new training distribution; not a single-factor ablation of previous failures
